meta.repair: THE REPAIR IS A REAL TRIM: on a repeated quadruple the rule removes the boundary cell of the TAPE (L <- L+1 or R <- R-1) on the side its own action table selects for that state (side read from TABLE[2*b2+b1], c1a inverted, exactly as the trim=5 variant reads it), re-opens the window on the narrower tape and continues.  The tape only shrinks, so at most n repairs are possible.
meta.engine: probe_cycle_cut/cut_engine.py: cyc_engine.py with one branch added (mode 4); modes 0,1,2,3 untouched
meta.charge: pcr_lib INC accounting in both models; a repair pays the re-span a rule-initiated cut pays, abs(y-L)+abs(x-R_) plus the head re-read; the oracle bit is free and takes no step
meta.compared: probe_cycle/cyc_cells.json (the retraction run) is left untouched and is the left column of the n=512 comparison
